اقتطعت (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَعْتُ (iqtaṭaʕtu) /iq.ta.tˤaʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اِقْتَطَعْتَ (iqtaṭaʕta) /iq.ta.tˤaʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اِقْتَطَعْتِ (iqtaṭaʕti) /iq.ta.tˤaʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اِقْتَطَعَتْ (iqtaṭaʕat) /iq.ta.tˤa.ʕat/: third-p
